terminus.finding: A file titled 台大中正史坦威_100-1-1書面報告.pdf looked superficially like a possible student report, but content inspection identifies it as a formal National Taiwan University expenditure-audit report dated 2011-09-22, with named audit committee members, procedure, evidence and findings. Filename semantics alone are therefore unreliable for authorship, genre and quality classification.
terminus.candidate: Quality judgment must follow provenance/genre identification from internal evidence, not title heuristics. Administrative and institutional reports can be high-value factual ore even when they offer little conceptual originality.
terminus.next: continue sampling likely student/course materials, but classify author and genre from internal evidence before scoring argument, evidence, originality and reusable parts

phase: small-batch mining with provenance-first, genre-aware quality scoring
